name: second-brain
description: Maintain a second-brain wiki with Codex — ingest sources, query the wiki, lint it.

interface.shortDescription: Ingest sources into an interlinked wiki, query it with citations, and lint it.
interface.longDescription: Second Brain turns an agent into a disciplined wiki maintainer. Sources under raw/ stay immutable; the wiki compounds. /ingest reads a source, discusses takeaways, writes a source page and ripples updates across affected pages. /query answers from the wiki in layers with citations. /lint checks link integrity, structure, graph health, content drift, readability, and gaps.
interface.defaultPrompt: Ingest the newest source under raw/ and ripple the updates across the wiki.
